source_text: A similar trial in Rakai, Uganda, involving 4,996 men aged 15-49, reported a 51% efficacy (adjusted hazard ratio 0.49; 95% CI 0.26-0.93) after 24 months, rising to 60% after excluding baseline seroconverters.
